name: Ibex skull
description:
The ibex skull presents a detailed view of its overall anatomy, revealing both functional and structural features. The upper dentition is clearly visible, with well-developed teeth adapted for cutting and processing vegetation. The bony core of the horns emerges from the top of the skull, showing the internal support that sustains their external growth. Large eye sockets indicate a wide field of vision, essential for detecting movement in mountainous terrain. The nasal cavity is also prominent, adapted to support breathing in cold and thin air at high altitudes. Altogether, the skull reflects a balance between strength, sensory capability, and adaptation to a rugged environment.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Animated Styracosaurus Albertensis
description:
Styracosaurus albertensis was a dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period, around 75 million years ago, mainly in what is now Alberta, Canada. It was an herbivore, feeding mostly on low-growing plants like shrubs and cycads. Its most distinctive feature was its large frill decorated with long spikes and a prominent nasal horn, which likely served for defense against predators and possibly for display during mating or social interactions. Styracosaurus was about 5.5 meters long and 1.8 meters tall, with a heavy, muscular body that helped protect it from predators such as Albertosaurus. It likely lived in herds, which would have provided additional safety. Its sharp beak allowed it to efficiently bite through tough vegetation. Overall, the spikes and horns of Styracosaurus were crucial for defense, species recognition, and possibly dominance displays within the herd.

name: Bovine Femur  (Bos taurus)
description:
High-resolution 3D anatomical scan of an isolated Bovine Femur (Bos taurus).

This digital model delivers a precise and detailed representation of the proximal hindlimb osteology in large ruminants. It highlights key anatomical landmarks of the bovine femur, such as the prominent spherical femoral head (caput femoris) with its distinct fovea capitis, the massive greater trochanter (trochanter major) that does not extend above the head (unlike in equines), the deep trochanteric fossa, and the robust distal trochlea and condyles for articulation with the patella and tibia. It serves as an essential digital resource for veterinary students, morphologists.

Source / Provenance: This specimen is part of the anatomical collection curated by Professor Antonio Palladino, Professor of Veterinary Anatomy, Histology, and Embryology at the University of Rome Tor Vergata.

Suggested Use: Educational purposes, veterinary research, comparative anatomy study, and scientific visualization.

オーストラリアに生息するヒクイドリは、世界最大級の飛べない鳥で、「世界一危険な鳥」とも称される。人に遭遇することは少ないが、鋭い爪を持ち、ひなを守る際には攻撃的になることがある。一方で、熱帯雨林の生態系において種子の拡散という重要な役割を担い、オスが育児を担当する珍しい特徴も持つ。人間との危険な遭遇の多くは、餌付けによる行動の変化が原因とされ、ヒクイドリに近づかないことが推奨されている。また、黒や濃紺の車に映る自分の姿をライバルと勘違いすることがあるため注意が必要である。

The cassowary, native to Australia, is one of the world's largest flightless birds and is often referred to as the "most dangerous bird in the world." While encounters with humans are rare, they possess sharp claws and can become aggressive when protecting their chicks. On the other hand, they play a crucial role in the ecosystem of tropical rainforests by dispersing seeds, and they have the unique characteristic of males being responsible for childcare. Many dangerous encounters with humans are attributed to behavioral changes caused by feeding, so it is recommended to avoid approaching cassowaries. Additionally, caution is needed as they may mistake their reflection in black or dark blue cars for a rival.

To świetna wiadomość dla polskich graczy, którzy chcieliby doświadczyć tej niezwykłej opowieści w swoim ojczystym języku, a także lepiej zrozumieć bogate dialogi i specyficzny humor gry.

Undertale to nietypowa gra RPG, w której decyzje gracza mają ogromny wpływ na przebieg fabuły. Gra słynie z niebanalnych postaci, głębokich wyborów moralnych oraz rozbudowanych dialogów. Oryginalnie napisana po angielsku, Undertale może być wyzwaniem dla osób, które wolą grać w swoim języku – dlatego fanowskie spolszczenie to idealne rozwiązanie.
